data.summary: Most core plan limits and eligibility details are supported by the parsed PDS, but there are actionable concerns: the product_name values appear to duplicate the tier already captured in plan_name, the Basic record may misstate/omit Section E3 baggage-before-boarding cover, and coverage_benefits is left null despite the PDS containing a detailed benefits table for each level.

findings.reason: All four product_name values include the plan tier (Basic/Budget/Standard/Top) even though plan_name separately captures the tier. The schema defines product_name as the product or PDS family name, excluding individual plan tier where possible.
findings.source_quote: There are four levels of cover available under this Tick Cruise Travel Insurance

findings.reason: The Basic record says baggage before boarding (E3) is not included/has Nil cover and is only available on Budget/Standard/Top. The PDS states Section E3 is available under any level of cover, although the benefits table OCR is somewhat ambiguous, so this should be reviewed against the original table.
findings.source_quote: Baggage and personal effects before boarding – Section E3 (available under any level of cover selected)

extracted_value.conditions: Economy class only; must claim from transport provider first; written confirmation required.

extracted_value.evidence: p14 B3; p27 Section B3 notes

extracted_value.benefit: Baggage before boarding (E3) and baggage delay before boarding (E5)
extracted_value.conditions: Only available on Budget/Standard/Top (E3) and Standard/Top (E5).

findings.reason: coverage_benefits is null for all products, but the PDS contains a detailed Table of Benefits by cover level. The schema defines coverage_benefits as all plan benefits from benefits tables and policy wording, so this appears materially incomplete even though many headline fields were populated elsewhere.
findings.source_quote: TABLE OF BENEFITS APPLICABLE TO INDIVIDUAL, COUPLE AND FAMILY COVER
